name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: TEST SQL-BY-EMAIL BUILD (v0.6.4.5): the send path touches NSS not at all -- doCleanup(email) takes the signing identity's email (win.gCurrentIdentity.email), opens raw cert9.db via Sqlite.sys.mjs, and finds/deletes the stale duplicate purely by SQL using the NSS column ace534352 = CKA_NSS_EMAIL (0xCE534352) with a case-insensitive LOWER() match, only ever on CKO_CERTIFICATE rows (hex(a0)='00000001'). No getCerts()/findCertByDBKey() (referenced via 0.6.4.1 + fact #3); findCertByEmailAddress()/findCertByNickname() do not exist in nsIX509CertDB. Email is Uint8Array-encoded, TextEncoder. Shutdown keeps doCleanupFin() (the full v0.6.3 pass: getCerts + email filter + SQL read + constructX509/deleteCertificate) where disturbing NSS state is harmless at exit. Purpose: verify a signed send with zero NSS-touch keeps reading of incoming mail working.
